organizations.publicNote: The linked 1930 disc bears the Ultraphon imprint and was issued by N.V. Küchenmeister’s Internationale Ultraphoon Maatschappij in Amsterdam and Berlin. This imprint should not be confused with the later Prague firm Ultraphon, established in 1933 and described in LCNAF no2024052021.

sources.fullCitation: Alfred Beres mit Orchester, with refrain sung by Eric Helgar. “Nur Tango, nur Tango,” tango from the sound film Alraune; music by Dr. B. Kaper, words by Fr. Rotter. Ultraphon A 744, matrix 15875, coupled with “Wenn du mal in Hawaii bist …”. One 25 cm shellac disc at 78 rpm, issued by N.V. Küchenmeister’s Internationale Ultraphoon Maatschappij, Amsterdam and Berlin. Deutsche Nationalbibliothek, Deutsches Musikarchiv, record 381098265.
sources.title: Nur Tango, nur Tango — Ultraphon A 744

sources.researchNote: The DNB MARC record supplies no historical recording or issue year: field 264 has no publication-date subfield, and field 008 leaves the historical year blank. The film association does not date this pressing. Field 028 identifies Ultraphon A 744 and repeats matrix 15875; repetition is not interpreted as a second matrix or assigned to the coupling. The personnel wording is “Alfred Beres mit Orchester, Refraingesang: Eric Helgar”. Field 777 links the coupling “Wenn du mal in Hawaii bist …” as record 381098273; that title does not by itself establish Kaper’s authorship of the other side. A Decca F 40007 / FGB 2355 reference concerns a different recording and is not used to identify or date the Ultraphon issue.
